source_binding: All final checks bind the committed production Go files. Both final pin suites also bind every committed test file. The broad selections precede one added late-startup test, which both final pin suites pass. The final prose check binds all seventeen committed files. Raw records retain generated documentation and concurrent module inputs separately.
limits: The original regression fails because collection removes the original selected generation after an origin republishes its payload at a new generation ID.

A running pinned runtime now holds its original selection through the configured store read lease. The authority publisher forwards that capability through a private read-only value without exposing its raw publication store.

The first implementation bypassed a wrapper Get method. Broader tests report three rejected-artifact subcase failures and their parent on each Go toolchain. The corrected client preserves configured reads and compares the returned manifest and payload with the leased artifact.

Tests cover caller-owned bytes on memory and filesystem stores, missing embedded artifacts, explicit read errors, changed identity, payload or manifest, cancellation, combined read and release errors, unsupported stores, failed startup, a later writer-service startup failure, and delayed shutdown.

The original source lint reported seven diagnostics in earlier CSP5 code. Repairs separate checkpoint decoding, migration stage preparation, partial-removal verification, and retained startup. Checkpoint indexes now use checked conversion. File timestamps compare instants with Time.Equal. An intermediate lint retained one complexity diagnostic; final lint passes without policy changes or suppressions.

Both final pin selections pass 62 race test events. Both recovery selections pass 240 events. These counts include parent tests and overlap; repeated toolchains do not establish additional distinct test cases. No selected test fails or skips.

The earlier complete storage and permission package run passes 320 race events. Its retained snapshots bind the storage and permission implementation before later root/runtime changes. It does not qualify those later changes.
The first final prose run reports one seven-sentence paragraph. A paragraph break resolves it; the failed and passing records remain archived.
Root dependency and catalog dependency-direction gates pass. No new request-path storage read or provider acquisition is added; leasing occurs during explicit generation reads and pin startup.

Only memory and filesystem support generation leases today. Minimum store implementations preserve their prior behavior. Object generation retirement and shared-store read protection remain incomplete.

Runtime leases last until shutdown. Collectors still must include configured pins and other persistent requirements in RequiredGenerationIDs, including after a runtime closes. Automatic runtime collection remains incomplete.

Observation-file collection, distinct-inventory retirement, twelve mapped subcases, full verification, required review, native CI, and merge remain open. This checkpoint does not qualify native Windows or Linux runtime behavior. CSP5 remains unpublished until its full contract passes.
Five concurrent tooling edits remain outside the source commit. Final task qualification must use its final committed module graph.
The final canonical prose check passes. Source snapshots separate the concurrent tooling edits from six owned documentation files. Task criteria, scope, invariants, and the goal remain unchanged.
